name: YTL
recent: YTL Corporation Berhad 于2026年11月19日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收同比增长34%至102亿令吉，税后利润增长5%至7亿令吉。公司持续进行凭单转换和ESOS行使，导致新股上市。此外，公司将于2026年12月3日召开第43届常年股东大会。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，营收同比增长34%至102亿令吉，税后利润增长5%至7亿令吉。
宣布第43届常年股东大会将于2026年12月3日举行。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年10月至11月期间多次申报其持股变动。
公司持续通过凭单转换和ESOS行使发行新股，导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为88.17亿令吉，环比增长16.5%，同比增长15.3%；净利润为3.28亿令吉，环比增长0.5%，同比下降47.1%；净利率为3.7%，低于上一季度的4.3%。

recent_en: YTL Corporation Berhad announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, with revenue up 34% year-on-year to RM10.2 billion and profit after tax up 5% to RM700 million. The company continued to see new share listings from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 34% year-on-year to RM10.2 billion and profit after tax up 5% to RM700 million.
Announced that the 43rd Annual General Meeting will be held on 3 December 2026.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) made multiple notifications of changes in its shareholdings during October and November 2026.
The company continues to issue new shares through warrant conversions and ESOS exercises, leading to a gradual increase in share capital.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM8.817 billion, up 16.5% quarter-on-quarter and up 15.3% year-on-year; net income was RM327.6 million, up 0.5% quarter-on-quarter and down 47.1% year-on-year; net margin was 3.7%, lower than 4.3% in the previous quarter.
